tasks.title: Add batch log queries and millisecond log timestamps
tasks.spec: specs/coder-session-tracking/spec.md#Requirement: Session log persistence preserves deterministic grouped ordering
tasks.description: Add `findBySessionIds(sessionIds)` to the session stream and workflow log repositories, and make new log inserts write millisecond-precision ISO timestamps from application code. Keep read ordering deterministic for mixed old and new data by preserving `ORDER BY created_at, rowid` anywhere session log order matters.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionStreamLogRepo exposes `findBySessionIds(sessionIds)` that returns rows grouped by session id and ordered by `created_at, rowid`
WorkflowLogRepo exposes `findBySessionIds(sessionIds)` that returns rows grouped by session id and ordered by `created_at, rowid`
New `session_stream_log` inserts store millisecond-precision ISO `created_at` values generated in JavaScript instead of SQLite `datetime('now')`
New `workflow_log` inserts store millisecond-precision ISO `created_at` values generated in JavaScript instead of SQLite `datetime('now')`
Existing second-precision rows still read in deterministic order because ordering keeps the `rowid` fallback
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task delivers the repository and timestamp foundation without changing the issue sessions list contract yet.

tasks.title: Make issue session list API metadata-only
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Requirement: Issue coder session list endpoint returns summary metadata only
tasks.description: Refactor `GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions` so it returns only session summary fields needed by the issue detail page and stops loading per-session logs entirely. Preserve the dedicated `GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions/:sessionId` detail path as the only source for transcript reconstruction and full workflow/session logs.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions` does not call per-session session stream or workflow log queries
The list response no longer includes a `workflowLogs` field or any transcript payload
The list endpoint reads from `coder_session` metadata only, plus other fields that are cheaply available without log scans
`GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions/:sessionId` still returns the full detail payload needed by SessionPage
For an issue fixture with 50 or more sessions, the list endpoint responds in under 1 second in the project verification environment
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the API boundary explicit: list is summary-only, detail remains log-backed. Do not reintroduce an `includeLogs` flag.

tasks.title: Update session list UI to use summary payload and cached queries
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-ui/spec.md#Requirement: Issue detail session surfaces consume summary session payloads
tasks.description: Split the frontend coder session types into summary and detail contracts, update list-oriented components to consume the summary shape, and remove dependence on `workflowLogs`-derived counts in the issue detail session surface. Configure `useCoderSessions` with a short non-zero `staleTime` so switching away from and back to an issue reuses recent list data instead of immediately refetching.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend API and type definitions distinguish a coder session summary payload from the full session detail payload
SessionList and SessionDetail render correctly without reading `workflowLogs` from the list response
The list surface removes or replaces `filesChanged` and `toolCalls` without introducing type errors
SessionPage still loads full transcript and log detail through the dedicated single-session endpoint
`useCoderSessions` uses an issue-scoped cache key with a non-zero `staleTime` of about 30 seconds
Navigating away from and back to the same issue within the stale window does not trigger an immediate refetch for the list query
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/web/src/lib/types.ts, packages/cli/web/src/lib/api.ts, packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useCoderSessions.ts, and session list/detail components
tasks.notes: Prefer removing the expensive derived counts entirely in this change unless a lightweight persisted source already exists.

tasks.title: Add performance and regression coverage for session list split
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-ui/spec.md#Requirement: Issue-scoped session list queries reuse recent data briefly
tasks.description: Add focused automated coverage for the new summary/detail boundary, repository ordering guarantees, frontend query caching, and the high-session-count performance target. The tests should prove the list path no longer regresses into log-backed N+1 behavior while the dedicated session detail page continues to work.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover `findBySessionIds(sessionIds)` ordering for mixed millisecond and legacy second-precision log rows
Tests verify the list API response shape excludes `workflowLogs` and does not require per-session log loading
Tests verify the single-session detail API still returns the full payload needed for transcript rendering
Frontend tests or query-level tests verify the session list uses cached data within the configured stale window
A performance-oriented verification for an issue with 50 or more sessions demonstrates the list endpoint stays under the 1 second target
All relevant tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/tests and packages/cli/web test coverage for coder session list/detail behavior
tasks.notes: This task depends on the implementation tasks so the assertions cover the final API contract, UI behavior, and ordering semantics together.
